scope: Real stateless facade with AES-GCM, HMAC, RE2 literal matching, typed results and owner/rule verification; configured static synthetic key; scalar one-value workloads.
measurement: perf_counter_ns per operation, nearest-rank percentile; warmups excluded; startup/configuration compilation and HKDF excluded.
upstream: None: no HTTP/MCP/model inference or synthetic upstream delay.
limitations: Local microbenchmark; not end-to-end gateway latency or universal throughput guarantee.
Background OS/application activity is not isolated; no fresh transport matrix is inferred.
Byte expansion is measured UTF-8 length, not model tokenizer counts.
Long recovery tokens must be copied exactly by an upstream model; model round trips are separate evidence.
